title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
summary: Anthropic has acquired Stainless, a company specializing in API development tools and SDK generation, to enhance the developer experience for Claude API users. Stainless is known for maintaining OpenAPI specifications and building developer-friendly tools.
problem_solved: Accelerates Anthropic's ability to provide better API developer tooling and documentation for Claude integration.
why_valuable: Acquiring Stainless gives Anthropic access to a talented team already experienced in building high-quality API developer experiences, which can significantly improve how developers integrate with Claude.
